'''Trai Novi''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender/Legends|His]] route included a run through [[Asair's Ribbon]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. He eventually appeared on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scanners who were stationed on Dantooine, prompting them to make an attempt to arrest him.
